method.method_draft: Read the velocity-time graph as a piecewise linear curve through the points (0,40), (5,0), (10,-20), (15,0), and (20,20), with velocity in meters/second and time in seconds. From the text, use the interval 0 <= t <= 20 and interpret 'total displacement' as signed area under v(t), not total distance. Compute the signed geometric areas: from 0 to 5, a positive triangle with area (1/2)(5)(40)=100; from 5 to 10, a negative triangle with area -(1/2)(5)(20)=-50; from 10 to 15, another negative triangle with area -50; from 15 to 20, a positive triangle with area (1/2)(5)(20)=50. Add signed areas: 100-50-50+50=50 meters.

method.method_draft: Read the same vertex values from the graph: v(0)=40, v(5)=0, v(10)=-20, v(15)=0, and v(20)=20. From the text, restrict the calculation to t=0 through t=20. Because each part of the graph is a straight line, compute displacement on each 5-second interval using average velocity times time: [(40+0)/2]5=100, [(0-20)/2]5=-50, [(-20+0)/2]5=-50, and [(0+20)/2]5=50. Sum these interval displacements to get 50 meters.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是速度函数 v(t) 的折线图，横轴为时间 t（seconds），纵轴为速度 v(t)（meters/sec）。从图上读出折线经过的关键点为 v(0)=40，v(5)=0，v(10)=-20，v(15)=0，v(20)=20，并且相邻点之间都是直线段。

推理：总位移等于速度-时间图像在 0≤t≤20 下的有符号面积。因为每段都是直线，可以在每个 5 秒区间用“平均速度 × 时间”计算位移。
0 到 5 秒：[(40+0)/2]×5=100。
5 到 10 秒：[(0+(-20))/2]×5=-50。
10 到 15 秒：[(-20+0)/2]×5=-50。
15 到 20 秒：[(0+20)/2]×5=50。
把这些有符号位移相加：100-50-50+50=50。因此总位移为 50 米。
